svg.text: Upstream Weekly — Adoption Check · Components Map
Candidates under evaluation · live public data · scores and verdicts by fixed rules · Gemini only writes the narrative · weekly snapshots, trend and decision log
ANY TIME — KEERTHI ADDS CANDIDATES AND RECORDS DECISIONS
EVERY MONDAY 04:30 UTC — HEALTH REFRESH (after the digest)
no keys needed; pypistats called at most weekly
• Determinism: scores, weight coverage, verdicts and reasons are computed in code from a versioned config; Gemini cannot change a number or a verdict.
• Honesty: missing data is “not available” with a reason; samples state their size; under 60% weight coverage the verdict is “Insufficient data”.
• Safety: additive tables only; the Monday digest is byte-identical while the email flag is off; refresh never overlaps the digest run.
